title: One of Our Kind
description: For fans of The Sellout and The Other Black Girl, a propulsive, daring satire of race and privilege set in an all-Black gated community from #1 New York Times best-selling author Nicola Yoon • "Brilliant, provocative, seminal....Your book club will be discussing this one for DAYS.” - Jodi PicoultJasmyn and King Williams move their family to the planned Black utopia of Liberty, California hoping to find a community...
